hardwareSemantics.rule: vs_1_1 diffuse oD0 is clamped to [0,1] before rasterization; no CPU DWORD quantization is applied to g_Color
hardwareSemantics.distinction: PT_3D_PLANE writes D3DXCOLOR to a DWORD vertex; PT_MESH/skin REAL_COLOR writes g_Color float to shader COLOR

confirmedMismatch: Unlit PBR converts texture to linear but consumes authored tint as linear, then converts the product back to gamma; native REAL_COLOR modulates display-space texture and tint directly. PBR also retains source material diffuse/alpha, which native REAL_COLOR does not use.
scope: Fragment-only adapter preserves Babylon vertex/skinning and existing native draw blend/depth scope. Explicit cartoon effects keep their own consumer.

pixelProbe.tool: tools/prepare-native-effect-pixel-probe.mjs creates an ignored standalone real-WebGL oracle page; run with --serve and read DOM #result. Runtime records are separate from source evidence.
sourceMeshCases: RF_HitP04 actual original SCA_CRIMSON_BREAK_P01 geometry and VERITABLE_PANDEMONIUM_T02 texture
HA_RRF_Reckless_Fiste_P01 actual 11-bone original geometry, source Normal pose sampled at .04 seconds and original texture
pixelProbe.independentOracle: Separate GLSL implementing the original Texture * saturated floating Diffuse, original source blend factors, and the same retained source geometry/bone skinning; compare real readPixels RGBA rather than particle counts.
pixelProbe.requiredVisibility: Both real meshes must have compiled actual draws and visibly non-background pixels; two blank frames cannot pass.
pixelProbe.legacyControl: Uses production hasAlpha=true, with original unlit PBR gamma processing retained; hardware-sRGB fallback tested separately.

limits: Matching independent original fragment math is narrower than full game-frame equivalence.
Emitter counts, dimensions, authored lifetimes and DrawCount are not reduced by this change.
